About Us

Concord isn't your typical consulting firm; we are an execution company with a passion for making things happen. Our mission is to help clients enhance customer experiences, optimize operations, and revolutionize their product offerings through seamless integration, optimization, and activation of technology and data.

We are purpose-built, merging the industry’s top specialty companies to amplify our Innovation Capabilities in analytics & AI, data management & engineering, UX and digital experience development, and technical platform integration, automation & security engineering.

About The Role

We are seeking a Lead DevOps Engineer to join our client’s Global Business Services team , where the mission is to improve and transform internal technology infrastructure, including IT operations, workplace technologies, cybersecurity, architecture, engineering services, and enterprise systems.

The Lead DevOps Engineer is responsible for designing, building, and optimizing enterprise-scale software systems and cloud platforms. This role combines deep technical expertise with leadership in DevSecOps, platform engineering, and cloud architecture.

You’ll drive innovation, ensure engineering excellence, and lead cross-functional initiatives to deliver secure, scalable, and high-performing solutions. In addition to technical execution, you’ll play a key role in mentoring teams, influencing technical strategy, and integrating emerging technologies such as generative AI into engineering practices.

You’ll report to the Manager of DevSecOps Engineering and work alongside a collaborative team of engineers. As part of a global DevOps community, you’ll join a network of professionals who collaborate, support, and inspire each other while investing in continuous learning and innovation.

What You'll Do

  • Lead the design and engineering of scalable, secure, and resilient enterprise software and cloud platforms.
  • Define and implement best practices in software development, DevSecOps, and infrastructure automation.
  • Oversee deployment, monitoring, and maintenance of platforms using SRE principles.

  • Translate complex business requirements into scalable technical solutions and roadmaps.
  • Mentor and coach engineering teams, fostering a culture of collaboration and continuous improvement.
  • Explore and integrate generative AI technologies to enhance automation and software capabilities.

What We’re Looking For

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related technical field.
  • 7+ years of experience in software engineering, DevSecOps, or platform engineering.
  • 3+ years in a technical leadership role.
  • 2+ years of experience with AI and generative AI technologies, or equivalent exposure.
  • Proven background in enterprise-scale application and infrastructure operations.
  • Advanced scripting skills (Bash, Python) for automation and infrastructure tasks.
  • Deep expertise with programming frameworks (.NET, Java) and modern application development.
  • Extensive experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as Terraform, including module development.
  • Proficiency with CI/CD tools (Azure DevOps, Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions).
  • Strong architectural knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP).
  • Familiarity with SRE practices and tools for monitoring, incident management, and performance tuning.
  • Excellent problem-solving and decision-making skills in complex environments.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders and lead teams.
  • Relevant certifications (e.g., Azure/AWS DevOps, PSD) are preferred.

title: Backend Engineer
description:
Join a category-defining AI company building the future of SMB Growth.

At Atlas, we’re making AI-driven phone and voice interactions feel as natural and responsive as talking to a human. Our mission is to help small and mid-sized businesses scale with “AI Revenue Agents” that launch campaigns in minutes and qualify every lead in 60 seconds.

Founded in 2024 by serial entrepreneurs with successful exits, we’re a tight-knit team of 12 A-players who love solving hard problems and moving fast. If you’re excited about building systems that power real-world AI interactions at scale, we want to talk.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Backend Engineer (mid-level) to join our growing engineering team. You’ll help design and build the infrastructure that powers our AI agents, voice pipelines, and integrations with external APIs and customer CRMs. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced startup, enjoys end-to-end ownership, and wants their work to directly impact customer growth.

Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain backend services that support Atlas’ AI voice and ad agents.
  • Work with cloud-native tools (serverless functions, queues, storage, etc.) to ensure scalable, reliable systems.
  • Develop and manage APIs that integrate Atlas with third-party CRMs, ad platforms, and communication tools.
  • Ensure data security, authentication, and compliance across all systems.
  • Collaborate with product, AI, and frontend teams to deliver features quickly and iteratively.
  • Monitor and optimize system performance for speed, reliability, and cost efficiency.

Experience

  • 4–7 years in backend development (Node.js, C#, or Python preferred).
  • Strong understanding of APIs, microservices, and event-driven architectures.
  • Hands-on experience with at least one major cloud platform (Azure preferred).
  • Database experience (SQL + NoSQL).
  • Comfortable working with queues, messaging systems, and distributed architectures.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and a bias toward action in dynamic environments.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with API gateways or API management (APIM).
  • Familiarity with authentication providers (Auth0).
  • Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines, DevOps practices, and monitoring tools.
  • Background in high-availability systems, call flows, or real-time communications.
  • Agile startup experience where you’ve shipped quickly and iterated fast.

Why Atlas

  • Be part of a small, elite team where your code directly impacts thousands of businesses.
  • Work on cutting-edge AI systems bridging digital ads, real-time voice, and CRM workflows.
  • Fast-moving environment where your contributions are visible and valued.
  • Culture of ownership, honesty, and customer obsession.

title: Analista de Gestão de Processos Sênior
description:
A Unimed BH

Somos a Unimed-BH, uma das melhores operadoras de planos de saúde do Brasil. Há mais de 50 anos, nosso propósito é cuidar da saúde, e esse cuidado se traduz em inovação contínua, qualidade com custo acessível, ética e sustentabilidade para oferecer o melhor serviço aos nossos mais de 1.500.000 de clientes.

O nosso compromisso é proporcionar um ambiente pautado pelo respeito, pelo acolhimento e pela valorização ao nosso time de mais de 10 mil profissionais, entre colaboradores administrativos, assistenciais e médicos cooperados.

Todas as nossas oportunidades também são destinadas a pessoas com deficiência, pessoas de todas as orientações sexuais e identidades de gênero, de diferentes raças e etnias, e idades, sem qualquer tipo de distinção.

Acreditamos que agilidade e simplicidade são a melhor forma de trabalhar e estamos sempre prontos para sugerir novas soluções para serviços e produtos, afinal, a inovação está no nosso DNA, o que nos leva a inspirar nossos colaboradores a atuarmos juntos, como um só time, com foco do cliente.

Para isso, oferecemos um ambiente propício ao desenvolvimento e benefícios atrativos de mercado. Esperamos você para seguirmos juntos cuidando da saúde!

É necessário que tenha:

  • Graduação em áreas da saúde, gestão e/ou áreas afins;

  • Sólida experiência em planejamento e gestão de processos (ferramentas de análise e mapeamento, análise de causa-raiz, oficinas de processos e cadeia de valor);

  • Conhecimento avançado em Bizagi e metodologia BPMN;
  • Conhecimento intermediário em ferramentas de Design Thinking;

Será um diferencial, caso você tenha:

  • Desejável: Pós-graduação e/ou Certificações em Lean, Six Sigma, Agile, Scrum, CBPP, PMI, HCMP, BPMN e outras metodologias de gestão de processos e/ou projeto s;
  • Conhecimento em gestão de mudanças.

Como será seu dia a dia:

  • Conduzir a melhoria dos processos organizacionais, por meio do mapeamento das atividades, análise de dados e de processos, identificação de dores e oportunidades de melhoria, proposição de soluções, monitoramento das ações e mensuração de resultados, com o objetivo de eliminar burocracias desnecessárias, atuando com agilidade, simplicidade e foco do cliente.
  • Contribuir para o desdobramento da estratégia, proposição de indicadores e monitoramento dos resultados, por meio do acompanhamento de metas, proposição de ações e condução de reuniões de reporte à alta direção.
  • Atuar como consultor e/ou dono de processos, garantindo a disseminação transversal (ponta a ponta) da gestão por processos, do alinhamento entre as áreas e a estratégia da empresa, da promoção do engajamento das pessoas envolvidas, do levantamento de dores e da execução de oportunidades de melhorias.
  • Liderar projetos de melhorias de processos, assegurando o cumprimento dos prazos e entregas pactuadas, por meio da utilização de metodologias ágeis e/ou metodologias tradicionais, com foco em redução de desperdícios, redução de custos, racionalização de recursos, melhoria da qualidade e experiência do cliente.
  • Compartilhar boas práticas em análise e melhorias de processos, por meio da proposição e utilização de ferramentas de qualidade, para melhoria do desempenho e performance.

Horário e Local de Trabalho:

  • De 8hs às 18hs (seg. à sex). Modalidade híbrida após o período de experiência.
  • R: Inconfidentes,44, Funcionários.

A Unimed-BH respeita a diversidade e inclusão em todas as suas vagas. Sem distinção de gênero, orientação sexual, raça, religião ou deficiência.

title: Java React Developer
description:
We are seeking a highly skilled Full Stack Developer with strong expertise in React.js on the frontend and Java Spring Boot on the backend. The ideal candidate will have experience designing, developing, and deploying scalable web applications, integrating APIs, and working with relational databases like PostgreSQL . This role requires not only technical proficiency but also a problem-solving mindset, attention to detail, and the ability to thrive in an Agile/Scrum environment. Experience with containerization and orchestration tools such as Docker and Kubernetes is a strong plus.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain highly responsive web applications using React.js, Java Spring Boot, and PostgreSQL.
  • Build scalable backend services and RESTful APIs, ensuring performance, security, and reliability.
  • Implement reusable UI components and follow best practices in frontend development with React.js, JavaScript (ES6+), TypeScript, HTML5, and CSS3.
  • Optimize database queries and manage schemas using PostgreSQL and ORM frameworks (JPA/Hibernate).
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams including product managers, UI/UX designers, and QA engineers to deliver high-quality features.
  • Participate in the full SDLC (software development lifecycle), from requirements gathering to deployment and support.
  • Troubleshoot, debug, and upgrade existing applications.
  • Follow Agile best practices, including participation in sprint planning, daily stand-ups, and retrospectives.
  • Contribute to code reviews to ensure high coding standards and maintainability.
  • (Nice to Have) Support deployment and DevOps activities including containerization with Docker and orchestration with Kubernetes .

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • Strong experience in React.js , JavaScript (ES6+), TypeScript, HTML5, and CSS3.
  • Hands-on expertise in Java Spring Boot for backend development.
  • Experience in RESTful API design and development .
  • Proficiency in PostgreSQL and ORM frameworks like JPA/Hibernate .
  • Solid understanding of Git version control and branching strategies.
  • Strong problem-solving, analytical, and debugging skills.
  • Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies and working in cross-functional teams.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Docker for containerization and Kubernetes for orchestration.
  • Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure).
  • Familiarity with testing frameworks for frontend (e.g., Jest, React Testing Library) and backend (e.g., JUnit).

Este cargo promove a rápida adoção de novas formas de trabalho, coordena treinamentos e educação em campo, e apoia contratações para ampliar a capacidade. Os resultados esperados incluem aceleração na aquisição de novos clientes, maior conversão nas etapas do funil, aumento no volume de compras e vendas, melhor desempenho de produtos e expansão da cobertura de mercado nos territórios atribuídos.

Localização : Belo Horizonte - (MG) - modelo 100% campo

Responsabilidades:

  1. Apresentar e executar oportunidades (canal, geografia, produto, desempenho, atendimento ao cliente, iniciativas-chave, preço, etc.) utilizando todos os dados disponíveis. Construir e compartilhar o plano completo para recrutamento e aquisição de novos clientes.
  2. Construir e manter relações sólidas por meio de liderança com nossos Distribuidores Chave (Elite, Premier, Royal, Blue, etc.) e stakeholders internos para executar iniciativas estratégicas. Realizar reuniões periódicas para revisão de negócios dos territórios. Fornecer orientação aos escritórios regionais implementando planos de ação personalizados para cada rede.
  3. Ser um membro ativo em campo, ouvindo oportunidades de melhoria.
  4. Participar ativamente de atividades de prospecção, como feiras, estandes promocionais e eventos de recrutamento para apoiar a expansão da rede.

  6. Garantir que estratégias de incentivos, eventos, promoções de vendas e lançamentos de novos produtos sejam implementados e executados conforme orientação da Hy Cite.

Requisitos:

  • Experiência comprovada em vendas e gestão de equipes, com forte atuação em vendas diretas. Experiência prévia em marketing multinível é altamente desejável.
  • Capacidade demonstrada de trabalhar colaborativamente em equipes, com forte orientação de serviço tanto para stakeholders internos quanto para parceiros externos como Distribuidores.
  • Excelente comunicação escrita e verbal, com habilidade para engajar públicos técnicos e não técnicos. Capacidade de desenvolver planos estratégicos e apresentações de forma independente.
  • Forte habilidade de autogestão e priorização, com capacidade de lidar com tarefas, iniciativas e projetos com supervisão mínima, inclusive em ambientes de trabalho remoto.
  • Perfil analítico e proficiência na gestão de dados de vendas, com experiência prática (preferencial) em Excel e ferramentas de Business Intelligence como Power BI, Tableau, entre outras.
  • Orientação para resultados e execução, com atitude proativa, compromisso com a excelência e abertura para aprender sobre o negócio.
  • Fortes habilidades de negociação e construção de relacionamentos, com capacidade de influenciar stakeholders internos e parceiros externos (Distribuidores).

title: Senior Back-End Developer (Golang)
description:
About

Flatiron is a global remote software development company with engineers located around the world. We unite experts from diverse backgrounds and experiences in a collaborative culture to deliver exceptional products and services for our clients. As a forward-thinking software engineering company, we provide industry-leading solutions to complex problems in both the US and the UK. Operating in a fast-paced, agile environment, we specialize in software consulting for our clients. We offer a stimulating and rewarding environment for our team members. We value innovation, continuous learning, and professional growth, and we strive to create a workplace where everyone can thrive. Join us at Flatiron and be a part of a team that is shaping the future of software development.

Job Summary

This is a full-time fully remote working opportunity where you will be working as part of a Scrum team which requires working closely with other software engineers, stakeholders and contributors on the project. Working with respect to the US timezone is a requirement for the position. Attending meetings, being actively involved in the decision making process and collaborating with all of these stakeholders are essential parts of this position.

Responsibilities

  • Design, develop and deploy cloud based (public and on-premise) high performance, distributed and scalable voice and digital medias (message, chat and video) applications for public safety answering points (PSAP) utilizing best engineering practices
  • Define component architecture based on stories created by Product Owner
  • Evaluate feasibility of design/architecture by developing rapid prototypes or a minimum viable solution
  • Develop, design, code, unit test, debug, integrate, document and participate in full life cycle of software development activities based on AGILE principle
  • Diagnose, debug, and fix application operational issues in a timely manner
  • Assist deployment and production support teams to work through customer escalated issues and provide resolutions and root-cause analysis

Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience with Golang
  • Experience with Node.JS or Python in cloud development environment
  • Proficiency in database management and configuration in PostgreSQL, Redis, or AWS RDS, etc.
  • Development experience in AWS/Azure cloud platforms, as well as Kubernetes based cloud native platforms such as OpenStack, OpenShift, EKS, AKS, etc. Well versed with Docker Container and Microservices
  • Proficiency in data messaging and streaming technologies such as Kafka, or Zookeeper
  • Demonstrable experience in API architecture design and implementation
  • Experience working across all phases of product development lifecycle, including requirements definition, specifications, development, test, product release, and sustaining engineering
  • Proficiency with Object-Oriented design methodology
  • Experience with automated testing desired
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Self-managed proactive work style. Strong interpersonal and collaborative skills
  • Able to work independently and in a team environment
  • Desire to engage in extremely challenging assignments

Benefits

  • Yearly Office Allowance Budget
  • Macbook Purchase Support
  • Wellbeing Support

If you are a good fit for the position, please apply through LinkedIn.

We only accept CVs that are in English.

Flatiron has a zero tolerance to discrimination policy. In this regard, during the course of the evaluation of your job application and all your employment relation, if any, all discriminatory factors such as race, sex, sexual orientation, social gender definitions/roles, color, national or social background, ethnicity, religion, age, disablement, political opinion or any status that is protected under law shall be disregarded.

A VON HAUSEN CONSULTORIA é uma empresa líder em assistência técnica rural, especializada no desenvolvimento e capacitação de todo o setor Agro. Nossa equipe é composta por Agrônomos(as), Médicos(as) Veterinários(as), Biólogos, Zootecnistas, Engenheiros(as) de Alimentos, Engenheiros(as) Agrícolas e Técnicos(as) em Eletromecânica, todos(as) com ampla experiência para oferecer suporte técnico e estratégico a produtores, estudantes, administradores e demais profissionais do agronegócio.

O Desafio do Cargo

Buscamos um(a) Assistente Técnico(a) de Campo para integrar nossa equipe. Este(a) profissional será responsável por prestar assistência técnica e suporte direto aos produtores rurais, atuando como um elo crucial entre o conhecimento técnico especializado da VON HAUSEN CONSULTORIA e as necessidades práticas do campo. O objetivo é resolver desafios, otimizar processos e impulsionar a produtividade agropecuária nas regiões atendidas.

Principais Responsabilidades Diárias

  • Prestar assistência e suporte técnico contínuo diretamente no campo.
  • Realizar atendimento qualificado e proativo ao produtor rural, compreendendo suas demandas e oferecendo soluções.
  • Diagnosticar e solucionar problemas técnicos específicos das atividades agropecuárias.
  • Coletar, analisar e interpretar dados técnicos para subsidiar o desenvolvimento e a implementação de soluções eficazes.
  • Manter uma comunicação clara e eficiente, tanto com a equipe interna quanto com os produtores atendidos, garantindo o fluxo de informações e o acompanhamento das ações.

REQUISITOS INDISPENSÁVEIS PARA A CANDIDATURA

Para esta posição, é fundamental que o(a) candidato(a) atenda aos seguintes critérios mandatórios:

Experiência Comprovada em Assistência Técnica e Suporte de Campo:

  • Mínimo de 6 meses de experiência direta e comprovada na prestação de assistência técnica e suporte em campo.

Experiência em, pelo menos, uma das seguintes áreas do agronegócio:

  • Fruticultura
  • Olericultura
  • Grãos
  • Bovinocultura de Corte
  • Bovinocultura de Leite
  • Ovinocultura
  • Apicultura
  • Agroindústria

Registro Ativo em Conselho de Classe:

  • Possuir registro ativo e regularizado no conselho profissional pertinente à sua formação (Exemplos: CREA, CRMV, CRBIO, etc.).

Habilitação e Acesso a Veículo para Campo:

  • Possuir CNH (Carteira Nacional de Habilitação) válida , Categoria B ou superior.
  • Ter capacidade e acesso a um veículo para deslocamento em campo (seja veículo próprio, alugado ou emprestado). A empresa não exige a posse de um veículo, mas a disponibilidade e o uso para as atividades do cargo são requisitos essenciais.

Habilidades Analíticas Desenvolvidas:

  • Aptidão comprovada para coletar, analisar e interpretar dados técnicos complexos, transformando informações em soluções práticas e eficazes para os desafios do campo.

Excelência em Comunicação e Atendimento:

  • Demonstrar habilidades de comunicação verbal e escrita claras, objetivas e eficientes .
  • Experiência prévia e comprovada em atendimento direto e de qualidade ao produtor rural.

DIFERENCIAIS (O que Valorizamos)

Serão considerados um diferencial para a candidatura, adicionando valor ao seu perfil:

  • Formação técnica em áreas correlatas ao agronegócio.
  • Experiência anterior em funções similares à de Assistente Técnico de Campo.

title: Virtual Interior Designer / Stylist
description:
About Promethex AI

Promethex AI is a modern agency building AI-first, tech-forward teams that help fast-growing companies scale intelligently. We recruit, train, and manage talent across finance, logistics, production, marketing, creatives, technology, and customer experience—equipping them with advanced tools to deliver measurable impact.

We partner with leading luxury ecommerce and design-driven brands, giving our team members exposure to innovative industries and real opportunities for growth.

For this role, you will be dedicated to supporting a North American luxury ecommerce brand that has been in business for nearly 20 years. The company is a market leader with strong growth, a well-established reputation, and a wide customer base across the U.S. and Canada.

The Role

As a Virtual Interior Designer / Stylist , you will act as the creative director behind 3D product visualization. You’ll collaborate closely with the 3D rendering team to conceptualize and direct visually compelling room scenes, ensuring products are styled and positioned in ways that resonate with brand identity, current design trends, and customer lifestyles.

This role requires a strong sense of design aesthetics, market awareness, and the ability to translate brand essence into visually powerful interior concepts that help sell pieces through ecommerce and marketing channels.

What You’ll Do

  • Direct the creative styling and art direction for furniture renders and room scenes.
  • Develop styling concepts that reflect the brand’s identity and target audience.
  • Collaborate with 3D rendering artists to bring concepts to life with accuracy and visual impact.
  • Research and apply emerging interior design trends to keep visuals modern and market-relevant.
  • Select furniture pairings, color palettes, and décor elements to create balanced, compelling room settings.
  • Provide clear creative briefs and feedback to ensure renders meet styling and brand standards.
  • Work closely with marketing and product teams to align visuals with campaign goals and seasonal launches.
  • Incorporate AI-powered design and visualization tools into workflow where applicable.

What You’ll Need

  • 3+ years of experience in interior design, styling, or creative direction (ecommerce or furniture focus preferred).
  • Strong knowledge of interior trends, design aesthetics, and consumer preferences in North American markets.
  • Proven ability to create mood boards, style guides, and visual concepts.
  • Experience collaborating with 3D rendering teams or digital visualization workflows.
  • Excellent communication and feedback skills, with fluency in English for collaboration with North American teams.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple styling projects simultaneously.
  • AI-first mindset: openness to integrating AI tools for concepting, mood boarding, or visual enhancements.
  • Comfort working North American time zones.

Why Promethex AI?

  • Be part of an AI-first agency shaping the future of talent.
  • Work with a well-established North American brand with nearly 20 years in the market.
  • Access advanced AI and research tools to accelerate your work.
  • Competitive pay and growth opportunities across multiple product categories.
  • Remote-friendly, global team focused on innovation and measurable results.

title: Coordenador de Operações e Implantação
description:

Estamos em busca de uma pessoa responsável por planejar, coordenar e supervisionar as atividades relacionadas à operação e implementação de novos produtos, garantindo que tudo ocorra dentro dos padrões de qualidade, prazo e custo estabelecidos. Esta função envolve a gestão de equipes, processos, recursos e a interação com diversas áreas da empresa, garantindo a eficiência operacional, a conformidade com as políticas e regulamentos e otimizar os processos.

  • Elaborar planos de ação para a implementação de novos produtos, definindo cronogramas, recursos necessários e etapas a serem seguidas.

  • Assegurar que todas as operações de cartões estejam em conformidade com as políticas internas, leis e regulamentos aplicáveis, como as normas do Banco Central
  • Coordenar equipes multidisciplinares envolvidas na implementação e processos operacionais como equipes técnicas, de desenvolvimento, produtos, marketing, vendas, etc.

  • Identificar e avaliar os riscos associados à implementação, propondo medidas para mitigá-los.
  • Coordenar o treinamento da equipe e dos clientes sobre o uso e operação do novo produto.
  • Garantir que toda a documentação relacionada à implementação e operação do produto seja elaborada e atualizada.

Formação

title: Graphic Designer (Hunting)
description:
ABOUT SHEIN

SHEIN is a global online fashion and lifestyle retailer, offering SHEIN branded apparel and products from global network of vendors, all at affordable prices. Headquartered in Singapore, SHEIN remains committed to making the beauty of fashion accessible to all, promoting its industry-leading, on demand production methodology, for a smarter, future-ready industry. Founded in 2012, SHEIN has more than 16,000 employees operating from offices around the world, and continues to expand operations globally. Join SHEIN and be the future!

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are seeking a talented and versatile Graphic Designer (Hunting) to be the guardian of our brand's look and feel. This role is for a creative professional who is not only passionate about visual design but also understands how to leverage it to drive business results. You will be responsible for ensuring a cohesive and impactful brand presence across all touchpoints, from digital campaigns to physical events, with a strategic focus on performance and conversions.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Brand Stewardship: Act as the primary guardian of our brand identity, ensuring consistency and visual excellence across all internal and external materials.
  • Digital & Performance Design: Design and execute all digital marketing assets, including social media content, website pages, A/B tests for optimization, and promotional graphics, with a keen eye on conversion rates and performance metrics.
  • Presentations & Internal Assets: Create and produce compelling presentations and internal documents that communicate our brand story and key business strategies effectively.
  • Event & Experiential Design: Oversee the visual design for all external events, including creating event stands, booths, and all accompanying marketing collateral to ensure a memorable brand experience.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with marketing, sales, and product teams to translate business goals into visually stunning and effective design solutions.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience: Proven 8+ years experience in a design role with a strong portfolio showcasing a range of work across branding, digital, performance, and print.
  • Technical Skills: Proficiency with design software (e.g., Adobe Creative Suite, Figma) and a solid understanding of best practices for digital platforms.
  • Strategic Mindset: A data-driven approach to design, with a demonstrated ability to use performance metrics (like conversion rates and click-throughs) to inform creative decisions.
  • Communication: Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to articulate design choices and receive feedback effectively.
  • Attention to Detail: Meticulous attention to detail and a commitment to maintaining a high standard of quality and brand consistency.

At SHEIN, we believe that diversity is the force that drives innovation. We are committed to creating an environment where all voices are heard, valued and respected. All our vacancies are inclusive for people with disabilities, women, black people, LGBTQIAPN+ community and all types of diversity.

title: Senior Buyer - Procurement & Subcontracts
description:
JOB PURPOSE

Execute and coordinate end-to-end Procurement, Subcontracts, and/or Asset & Operations Procurement activities for assigned scopes, ensuring project requirements are delivered on time, within budget, and in compliance with governance standards. The role supports Lead Buyers/Managers in sourcing strategy implementation, conducts supplier engagement, and manages post-award activities — applicable across assigned discipline(s).

WORK SCOPE:

  • Sourcing Execution - Carry out sourcing activities from RFQ to award, ensuring compliance with approved strategies and governance processes.
  • Business Requirement Management - Work with stakeholders to confirm and clarify specifications or scopes, raising queries to resolve gaps.
  • Market & Vendor Intelligence - Gather and update market information, supplier capability data, and cost benchmarks to support sourcing decisions.
  • Tender & RFQ Management - Prepare and issue RFQs/ITBs, coordinate bid clarifications, and perform evaluations in line technical (QHSE, Finance including technical requirement) and commercial criteria.
  • Contract / PO Management (Post-Award) - Manage day-to-day execution, including expediting, monitoring Progress, updating VOWD, and ensuring documentation closure.
  • Vendor Performance Management -Track supplier/subcontractor performance, report non-conformance, and follow-up on corrective actions
  • Governance & Compliance - Adhere to COBC, ABC, P2P, and corporate governance requirements, ensuring readiness for audits.
  • Quality Control - Ensure that procurement/subcontract processes, documents, and outputs meet quality and compliance requirement standards before submission for approval
  • QHSE in Tendering & Contracting - Support QHSE adherence in all sourcing and contract execution activities.
  • Performance & Talent Development — Identify performance/development gaps and develop Individual Development Plan. Implement agreed learning and development needs.

QUALIFICATIONS / CERTIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor's Degree or Diploma in Supply Chain, Engineering, Quantity Surveying, Business Administration, or related field.
  • Professional certifications (e.g., CIPS, ISM)
  • Knowledge of SAP MM, contract law, incoterms, and procurement/subcontracting processes. Familiarity with BIMCO or equivalent contract forms (for relevant scopes).

title: Technical Support Representative
description:
Role: Technical Support Representative

Location: Sao Paulo, Brazil. Work from office.

Office location: Cenesp, Sao Paulo, Brazil

Languages required: German and English

The Internal/External Customer, Technical Support Representative provides Internal/External Customer Technical Support Services and supports our client’s customers in their navigation and use of applications, hardware and software necessary to complete actions related to doing business with our client. The primary function of these Help Desk services is to restore technical function as resolution in order to allow our client’s customer to return to their business process as quickly as possible. In relation to this service, the activities conducted by the Technical

Support Representative would include the following:

  • Interacting with our client’s customers who are contacting customer support for assistance via phone/email (potential future channels e.g. Chat)
  • Collecting and verifying information provided from the contact in order to accurately and quickly deliver solutions that restore service
  • Identifying correct knowledgebase solutions to use in performing necessary steps to deliver solutions that restore service
  • Working within a service management application to provide case logs for restoration rate accountability and process adherence
  • Escalating unresolved issues to the next level of support when required by process
  • Adhering to Priority service levels and assigning these appropriately for the described issue using provided support processes.

This position is the first point of contact for the end-user. Individuals must be able to multi-task in a fast paced, high pressure environment with customers of varying degrees of technical knowledge. Individuals will have common solutions available for technical problems encountered and will escalate if no knowledge-based solution exists. Individuals are required to identify and define problems, collect data, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions. TSR must be able to understand and interpret technical concepts and apply logic and deductive reasoning. Performs basic troubleshooting and ID resets for various applications.

Job Duties

  • Engage with first level support contacts from internal/external end-users
  • Communicate resolution to software/hardware errors & malfunctions
  • Provide feedback on procedures
  • Troubleshoot/dispatch basic hardware issues
  • Probe, isolate, and troubleshoot supported application problems
  • Handle general ID resets, email issues, Internet Explorer issues

title: Finance Intern - LATAM
description:
About the company

Recurrent Energy, a subsidiary of Canadian Solar Inc., is one of the world’s largest and most diversified platforms for developing, owning, and operating utility-scale solar and energy storage projects. With a global team of energy experts, we drive the transition to a cleaner and more sustainable future.

We are looking for a Finance Intern (Treasury) to join our team and support treasury operations across the LATAM region.

Responsibilities:

  • Support the preparation and maintenance of short- and long-term cash flow reports for LATAM.
  • Assist in daily cash management activities, including monitoring bank balances and transactions.
  • Contribute to monthly and quarterly treasury reports, as well as the tracking of key metrics such as liquidity and funding needs.
  • Provide support in maintaining and improving treasury controls, processes, and systems, as well as assisting with ad hoc analyses and requests.
  • Participate in special projects and initiatives related to financial operations across LATAM.

Requirements:

  • Currently pursuing a degree in Business Administration, Economics, Accounting, or Financial Management, with at least 3 semesters remaining.
  • Advanced English (Spanish is a plus).
  • Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and logical reasoning.
  • Proficiency in Excel (intermediate/advanced level).
  • Interest in financial management, treasury, and corporate operations.

Desired Profile:

  • Proactive and eager to learn in a dynamic environment.
  • Well-organized and detail-oriented.
  • Ability to work in multidisciplinary teams and collaborate across countries.
  • Clear and effective communication skills.
  • Resilient when facing technical and operational challenges.
